clue.text: Closing piece from Supertramp live: sit to play

explanation.walkthrough: PRESIDE can mean to take the featured seat at an instrument, as in 'preside at the piano'.
explanation.definitionFit: To preside at the keyboard is to occupy the performer's seat there, so the verb covers sitting down at an instrument to perform.

explanation.definitionFit: A reissue is a publication or record released again, so to reissue is to put something out a second time.
